note.question: How do across three real-world e-commerce data sets, UPSTAR substantially improve accuracy and, importantly, advances the system’s ability to surface genuinely exploratory items that drive discovery and cross-category sales?
note.overview: Retailers struggle to match recommendations to why customers buy. We introduce a practical framework that distinguishes two core, actionable purchase motivations, stable preference and exploratory intent, and present STB, a data-efficient measure that infers which motivation drives each item purchase using only transaction sequences and item attributes. Building on STB, we develop UPSTAR, a motivation-aware recommender that separates users’ behavior into stable-preference and exploratory subsequences and fuses their signals for next-item prediction.
